scope: Add a framework-neutral ASGI send/call boundary around the existing AsgiCoreProfileAdapter so a host can call one async method that emits http.response.start/body events through an injected send function, preserving existing handle behavior.

behavior: throws TypeError when send is not a function, without invoking the router
computes events via the unchanged handle({ scope, body })
awaits send(event) once per event in order
returns the same frozen event array handle would have returned
a rejecting send propagates and stops further sends

targeted: call rejects a non-function send without invoking the router
call awaits send for each event in order and returns the same events as handle
call propagates a rejecting send and stops without sending further events
tests.unchanged: repository-boundary.test.mjs and prior kernel-asgi-core-profile.test.mjs cases require no edits and remain GREEN
